quest.title: Tending to a Tepetlisaurus: In Search of a Recipe
quest.description: Cazcal seems to be trying out a whole new way of looking after Hora...

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Hmm... Looks like we'll need to try a different recipe...

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: Oroooo! Rrroooo!

choices.text: Another bright idea? Let's hear it then.

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: Normally Hora can finish a whole bowl of fruit, and once he's done, he'll go on playing all day long.

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: But now, he only eats half a bowl, then he just sits there not moving a muscle...

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: I was so worried he might be ill that I went to find a vet in the middle of the night to ask his advice.

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: The two of us spent the entire night trying to figure out what was wrong with him, only to realize he wasn't ill at all, just... a very picky eater.

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: The vet said that the best solution would be to find a new recipe.

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: He also said that I could try playing some music for Hora during mealtimes, that it might stimulate his appetite...

choices.text: That sounds like a great idea...

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: Hahaha, yeah, I did find a record, and Hora was pretty into it, too.

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: But we were forced to abandon that idea... when Hora jumped up and bit the record in half.

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: Don't look so shocked. From a Tepetlisaurus's point of view, a record made from obsidian and phlogiston is a tasty treat in itself...

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: Now, my only option is to head over to the Scions of the Canopy and see if anyone there can help me find some new ingredients to try out.

choices.text: I'll go find some ingredients for you.

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: You'd really help me out? That would be terrific! My Scion friends can only search within Natlan, but you could source ingredients from anywhere, couldn't you?

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: Hold up, let me look at the list of ingredients the vet recommended. That doc knows a lot, even about things beyond our borders...

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: Huh... It says that we can try <color=#00E1FFFF>"Rainbow Roses," "Lavender Melons,"</color> and <color=#00E1FFFF>"Qingxin."</color>

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: Thanks so much for doing this. If you come across any unique ingredients, just bring them straight back to me.

choices.text: I'm a pro when it comes to ingredient gathering.
I had no idea such records existed.

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Ah, yes! Please, take these for your trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Thanks to your help, I'm positive I'll be able to come up with the best recipe for Hora.

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Hora, start eating properly again, alright? That's how you'll grow into a big, strong Tepetlisaurus!

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: Rrooh, oroooo! Rrroooh!

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Now that's a pretty flower. Nice-sounding name, too... Hora, fancy a bite?

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: Wroo, rrooh!

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: (Hora chews it carefully, as if savoring the flavor of the petals.)

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: R—Roar...

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Oh! From the way he looks, I'd say he likes it a lot. But flowers on their own won't be enough to fill him up...

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Plus, this type of flower sure doesn't look cheap... Anyway, I'll just go ahead and write it down for now.

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: How do you make flowers into food? Oh, maybe we can... mix them into some kind of cake?

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Whoa, that's one big fruit! It should be enough to fill him up, from the look of it. Fancy a go at it, Hora?

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: Wroo, rrooh!

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: (Hora starts chomping away, and before long it's all gone.)

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: Oroooo! Rrroooo!

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Hahaha, gone in a flash. You must have liked that a lot, huh, kiddo?

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: Wroo, rrooh! Hroooo—

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Great! I'll go find someone to ask in a bit, see if anyone knows where to find Inazuman merchants. I need to get my hands on more Lavender Melons...

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: This one smells pretty good. Real refreshing aroma...

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Hora? You... Well, would you look at that! He's only gone and eaten it whole!

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: (Hora swallows the Qingxin in a single gulp, then blinks at you...)

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Hora suddenly turns around and eats up the half bowl of fruit next to him, all in one go...

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Hora's appetite seems to have returned all of a sudden... How did that happen? Was it really all thanks to this Qingxin thingamajig?

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: I—I have to talk to the vet about this...

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: So, found any unique ingredients?
